integrity.evidence: Exact integer acyclic matching, two independent Morse-chain reductions, determinant-one attaching minor and exhaustive face tests in verify.py and verified_output.txt.
integrity.scientific_interpretation: Integral CW attaching maps determine the stated homotopy equivalences; numerical Betti calculations alone are not used as a homotopy proof.
integrity.scope: Finite exhaustive proof for exactly the specified three triangular graphs.

scientific_limitations: Only triangular graphs on five, six and seven underlying points are classified; no n >= 8 extrapolation.
The result does not determine full symmetric-group equivariance, ring operations or general higher parameters.
Independent mathematical validation and definitive publication priority have not been established.
title: Mixed-dimensional two-independence homotopy of the triangular graphs \(T_5,T_6,T_7\)
